g.text: The same peaks, two different measures of spread
Circles: peaks used for area and cutoff-matched spacing · red ×: eligible peak below 0.25% activity
C05 s99: the +115-unit original NN difference vanishes with the area cutoff.
C15 s123: all 16 peaks pass; local NN rises by 100 units while global area falls by 0.028.
